notes: Two-color system, normalized to ink #262744 / paper #EEEEEE — 'muted' and 'accent' are the same ink because the site has no third hue; the roles map carries the real semantics (hover states swap the pair). No shadows or gradients exist on the page, so `shadow` is empty rather than invented. Type scale converted from px at the site's 22px base (16/18/22/36/58px); leading is 1.0 (line-height equals font-size on nearly every element) — reproduced honestly rather than rounded up to a house 1.5. `50%` radius belongs only to the modal's close button. Motion durations 1000ms/1200ms come from the load curtain and its bar keyframe, not from page choreography — the page's real interaction timings are 150ms (nav inversion) and 300ms (button swap). The profile's `scroll_effects` reported four `position: fixed` 'pins'; these are static fixed layers (nav, footer, cookie banner), not scroll-driven effects — only the class-toggled nav inversion is a genuine scroll effect, and the pinned-chrome entry is recorded for the layering story. `craft.theme.dark` is a false positive (the probe echoed the light palette; `supportsDark` is false), so no `color.dark` block. Hero blue is photographic, from a background JPEG — not a UI token.
